note: The weekly plan allowance, in plan units, that hooks/lib/session-budget.mjs quotes as a percentage in the session budget notice. A plan unit is a token count priced at the Sonnet 5 rates (the tier config/model-tiers.json planUsageMultipliers defines as 1.0) times the model's tier multiplier; see scripts/lib/pricing.mjs planPriceSpecFor. The figure is the operator's own reading, not a published limit: the usage postmortem of 2026-09-25..2026-10-02 put hits at about 2,650-2,900 units and the 2026-10-02 in-app reading at 1,700-2,200, so ~1,900 is the working number. Edit it here when the limit moves; it only changes the percentage in the notice, never when the notice fires (that is the session_budget_units option). Estimated turns: config/model-tiers.json planUsageMultipliers has no haiku or fable reading, and its note says not to extrapolate one for routing decisions. The budget hook has to count those turns somehow, so it counts them at their own API list price (haiku 0.5x, fable 5x the Sonnet 5 rate, the stand-ins the postmortem ledger used) and records how many in session-budget.jsonl estimated_turns. Add a measured multiplier to planUsageMultipliers when one exists and the estimate stops being used.
